meta.name: unit-economics
meta.description: Establishes whether the business makes money on each customer or unit — contribution margin, acquisition cost, payback period, lifetime value, and the cohort behavior underneath. Use this to assess whether growth is profitable, evaluate a channel or segment, support a pricing decision, judge how fast the business can afford to grow, or diagnose why revenue growth is not producing profit.

copy.tagline: 算清每个客户是否真正赚钱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管业务增长,需要判断每条客户渠道到底赚不赚钱。
copy.tagline_en: See if each customer actually makes you money
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage business growth and need to know which customer channels actually make money.

howto.what: 它会帮你把每个客户（或单位）到底赚不赚钱算清楚：先定好"一个客户"是什么，再算贡献毛利、获客成本、回本周期和生命周期价值，并用队列数据如实解读，提醒常见的算错点。
howto.when: 当你说要判断增长是否赚钱、评估某个渠道或客户群、支持定价等时触发。

say.text: 帮我算一下每个客户的贡献毛利和获客成本。
say.note: 会先定义单位，再按步骤算出结果。

say.text: 看看这个渠道的回本周期要多久。
say.note: 会拿获客成本除以月度贡献来算。

say.text: 用队列数据检查留存是在变好还是变差。
say.note: 会对比早期和近期的留存曲线。

howto.what_en: Defines the unit, then computes contribution margin, acquisition cost, payback period, and lifetime value from observed retention. Flags common errors (understating variable cost, excluding people costs) and advises segment/cohort interpretation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to assess whether growth is profitable, evaluate a channel or segment, support a pricing decision, or diagnose why revenue growth isn't producing profit.

say_en.text: Calculate contribution margin and acquisition cost per customer.
say_en.note: Defines the unit first, then computes.

say_en.text: How long is the payback period for this channel?
say_en.note: Divides acquisition cost by monthly contribution.

say_en.text: Use cohorts to check if retention is improving or worsening.
